title: Quantum Nondecimated Wavelet Transform: Theory, Circuits, and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2512.21478v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The quantum nondecimated wavelet transform uses a shift register to apply circular shifts to an amplitude encoded signal before a single orthogonal wavelet transform. We show that tracing out the shift register gives level probabilities equal to the normalized nondecimated wavelet energies, invariant under circular shifts. Its diagonal gives moving averages of squared coefficients. We derive a multinomial model for the level counts and show how to read the autocovariance at lag one for all but the coarsest detail level. For these global statistics, direct Fourier basis measurement of the input is at least as precise and uses a simpler circuit.   For denoising, we insert a block encoded shrinkage operator between the transform and its inverse. Postselection on the shift register implements the cycle spinning average exactly as a linear combination of unitaries. Weights shared within each level give a translation equivariant filt

translated_title: 量子非抽取小波变换：理论、电路与应用
translated_abstract: 量子非抽取小波变换使用移位寄存器在单个正交小波变换之前对幅度编码信号施加循环移位。我们证明，对移位寄存器求偏迹可得到等于归一化非抽取小波能量的层级概率，且该概率在循环移位下保持不变。其对角线给出系数平方的移动平均。我们推导了层级计数的多项式模型，并展示了如何读取除最粗细节层级之外的所有层级的滞后一阶自协方差。对于这些全局统计量，直接对输入进行傅里叶基测量至少同样精确，且所需电路更简单。对于去噪，我们在变换与其逆变换之间插入一个块编码的收缩算子。通过对移位寄存器的后选择，以酉算子线性组合的形式精确实现了循环平移平均。在每个层级内共享的权重给出了平移等变的滤波
tldr: 该论文提出了量子非抽取小波变换的理论与电路实现，证明了其层级统计量在循环移位下不变，并通过块编码收缩算子与移位寄存器后选择精确实现循环平移平均，从而完成平移等变的量子去噪。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the theory and circuits for a quantum nondecimated wavelet transform with shift-invariant level statistics, and achieves translation-equivariant quantum denoising by exactly implementing cycle spinning averages via a block-encoded shrinkage operator and postselection on the shift register.
